div.p:
The real assessment (pantrypal-assessment/): build v1 of an AI
cooking assistant against four intentionally-contradictory
stakeholder artifacts, in a self-timeboxed 3 hours.

This documents the brief itself (stakeholder asks + the
contradictions between them) and a plan for using the time box:
what's in scope, what's explicitly cut, and roughly how the
3 hours get spent.
